title: Cloud save: the cloud is further along (the choice dialog)
about: This phone is on spring 12 (2,150g, 1 h 30 min played); the cloud has summer 3 of year 1 from another phone (12,400g, 5 h played). The sync on start finds it and the one-thumb dialog opens: two cards with day, gold and play time, the cloud one marked 'further along', a full-width button under each, Decide later at the bottom. Nothing is uploaded until the player chooses.
